messages:
Claire: heads up — saw a burst where projectless keys got routed to Dedicated and consumed a ton of quota. looks like SA impersonation path fell back to originless routing and doubled token usage.
aj: timeframe? query?
Claire: last 15m, spike started ~1719821000. infra-bot alerted, 2.3x normal token rate from fallback.
infra-bot: ALERT: quota_routing_anomaly detected tenant=redwood-test spike=230% window=900s
samir: is this the change that preferred SA claim? we added that last week but kept fallback for legacy keys. might be an ordering bug.
deepa: UX question — if billing attribution flips between original key owner and impersonated SA, customers will be confused. what does console show today?
leo: current telemetry has origin_project vs effective_project. we should add routing_decision tag (explicit|fallback) and an impersonator_id label. that would make postmortems easier.
maria: +1. proposal: per-request trace fields: routing_decision, route_affinity(enum), fallback_type; also a counter metric quota_routing_fallback_total{fallback_type="sa-absent"}.
Claire: rollout plan: feature-flag sa_affinity, default on, org-level override, and a canary percentage. if we see anomalies, flip off per-org.
aj: sample flag syntax i propose (gateway reads):
```
auth.routing:
  sa_affinity: true
  sa_affinity_canary: "org:1234:5%"
```
samir: gateway impl detail: hash(org_id+key_id) % 10000 < threshold to avoid coordinator. simple and deterministic.
oliver: watch billing attribution — if tokens move to impersonated SA we change invoices for some customers. need billing sign-off.
deepa: UI idea: show both attributions in Console: billed_to and effective_for_debug with a toggle + explanation tooltip. reduces surprised emails.
leo: ops runbook stub: if quota spike, set sa_affinity=false for org, wait 5m, check token rate and billing tags, then roll forward. add alert when routing_decision=explicit drops below 90% on canary.
maria: i'll open the rollout PR and dashboard update. tagging @aj @leo for gateway + metrics work.
aj: ack, i'll take gateway canary and prometheus label changes. :thumbsup:
leo: will add runbook steps and a dashboard panel. :eyes:
Claire: thanks all — i'll follow up with PR links + canary checklist in this thread.
